Print Stylesheet Generator

Generate @media print stylesheets: hide nav and ads, pick page size and margins, plus an ink-saver mode, with copyable CSS.

Print Stylesheet Generator

A sensible @media print block for cleaner printed pages.

Hide when printing

Generated CSS


  





  
  


  

    

      
📖 How to use

      
  1. Tick the elements to hide when printing (nav, ads, sidebars...).
  2. Choose page size, orientation and margins.
  3. Enable ink-saver to strip backgrounds and dark colors.
  4. Click "Copy CSS" and paste it into your stylesheet.

    

    

      
❓ Frequently asked questions

      
Does it need JavaScript?
No JavaScript is involved — the output is a pure CSS @media print block.
Can I hide my own elements too?
Add the printed class names to the hide selector, or extend the generated rules with your own selectors.
Which page sizes are supported?
Yes — the generator covers A4, Letter and Legal, plus portrait or landscape orientation.
